tts/out/walldriver/01.mp3: This is the branch manager's drive on the orphan campaign.
tts/out/walldriver/02.mp3: Every prompt he puts on the tasks is counted in his own words and from the automation he set going.
tts/out/walldriver/03.mp3: His automation writes to clients, briefs the agents, and alerts the branch. Everyone is counted here.
tts/out/walldriver/04.mp3: This ring shows when the team answers his prompts. The same day, the next working day, or later.
tts/out/walldriver/05.mp3: Day by day, his prompt stand beside the team's notes.
tts/out/walldriver/06.mp3: And for each member of the team, how many notes came after a prompt and what those notes say?
